summary: Completed comprehensive testing of HooHlyaShop Fashion Catalog Website. Backend APIs are 96.6% functional with excellent performance. Frontend UI loads properly with working navigation, language switching, and contact integration. One minor cart persistence issue identified.

flaky_endpoints.impact: Admin panel product editing may fail

ui_bugs.issue: Cart state not persisting after adding products - items don't appear in cart page

integration_issues.issue: Products can be added to cart but don't persist when navigating to cart page

passed_tests: Homepage loads with hero section, how-it-works, and featured brands
Language switcher toggles between EN/DE successfully
Catalog page displays products with tetris grid layout
Product filters (brand, category, search) work correctly
Product detail page shows image gallery and product information
Admin login works with correct password (hoohlyaadmin2024)
Admin panel CRUD operations for brands, categories, reviews
WhatsApp/Telegram/Instagram contact buttons present in footer and product pages
Navigation between all pages works correctly
Order creation and PDF generation functionality
action_item_for_main_agent: Fix cart state persistence issue - products added to cart are not showing up in the cart page. This appears to be a localStorage or React context state management issue. Also investigate the product update API validation error (422 status).
